title: Track 12 — rezzy-cli: Deterministic JSONL Aggregation, .rezzy-meta.jsonl Sidecar & Signed Federation Crawler (0.6.0-rc.1)
public_safety_audit_summary: Moderate (Forensic Integrity & Replay Pollution): Deduplicating raw JSONL events by their Matrix redacted canonical form (reference-hash input) and stripping non-envelope ingestion markers (__rejected, __soft_fail, __pducount) into an optional .rezzy-meta.jsonl sidecar (--no-provenance) risks replaying rejected or unverified events if downstream state-resolution consumers read merged-<room>.jsonl without enforcing sidecar rejection claims and signature checks.
